assertion_results.text: Performance goal is made measurable with a specific metric and numeric target
assertion_results.evidence: "Reduce initial dashboard load time to under 2 seconds" and "Reduce the number of network requests made during initial render by at least 30%."

assertion_results.text: 'Look nicer' is replaced with concrete, enumerable UI changes
assertion_results.evidence: The output lists concrete UI changes including "Use consistent spacing, typography, colors, and component styles", "Ensure cards, charts, tables, and controls align to a consistent grid", and "Improve responsiveness".

assertion_results.text: Includes how completion would be verified or tested
assertion_results.evidence: Acceptance criteria include "Before/after performance measurements are recorded using the project’s existing performance tooling or Lighthouse", "All dashboard pages pass existing automated tests", and "A reviewer can identify the main improvements from a visual comparison of before and after screenshots."
